emergent_bug.violated_requirement: ρ = atomic([read(inet_saddr)]) from thread_b -- connect reads the bound source address under the socket lock and assumes no concurrent unsynchronized mutation
emergent_bug.violating_event: e@raw_bind:739 = WRITE(inet_rcv_saddr = inet_saddr = addr->sin_addr.s_addr) by thread_a
emergent_bug.missing_guarantee: thread_b (connect) holds the socket lock, but thread_a (raw_bind) writes the fields WITHOUT lock_sock() -> the writer is outside the lock the reader relies on -> no common lock serializes bind against connect
emergent_bug.category_rationale: ρ is atomic(single access); a concurrent unlocked write to the same field breaks it -> data race (bind/connect must be serialized by the socket lock)

fix_maps_to: patch wraps the raw_bind() body in lock_sock(sk)/release_sock(sk) -> adds serialize(socket lock, write) on the writer side -> both sides hold the same lock -> establishes ρ
recall_risk_notes: Textbook one-sided missing lock: the writer takes no socket lock while the reader path holds it. Static gives candidate 'no lock' on raw_bind vs lock_sock on connect -> not same_lock -> fires. Minor risk: the reader site is described generically ('source-address read' at datagram.c:39); LLM/static must confirm it actually reads inet_saddr. Object identity via inet_sk(sk) is clear.
